table msb_web_sales , columns = [ msb_web_sales.ws_net_paid ( decimal | comment : web net paid ) , msb_web_sales.d_date ( date | comment : sale date ) , msb_web_sales.d_year ( bigint | comment : calendar year ) , msb_web_sales.d_moy ( bigint | comment : calendar month ) , msb_web_sales.retail_fy ( integer | comment : retail fiscal year starting February 1 ) , msb_web_sales.i_item_id ( varchar | comment : item id ) , msb_web_sales.i_category ( varchar | comment : item category | values : Sports , Books ) ]
table msb_catalog_sales , columns = [ msb_catalog_sales.cs_net_paid ( decimal | comment : catalog net paid ) , msb_catalog_sales.d_date ( date | comment : sale date ) , msb_catalog_sales.d_year ( bigint | comment : calendar year ) , msb_catalog_sales.d_moy ( bigint | comment : calendar month ) , msb_catalog_sales.retail_fy ( integer | comment : retail fiscal year starting February 1 ) , msb_catalog_sales.i_item_id ( varchar | comment : item id ) , msb_catalog_sales.i_category ( varchar | comment : item category | values : Sports , Books ) ]
table msb_store_returns , columns = [ msb_store_returns.sr_return_amt ( decimal | comment : return amount ) , msb_store_returns.sr_return_quantity ( bigint | comment : return quantity ) , msb_store_returns.d_date ( date | comment : return date ) , msb_store_returns.d_year ( bigint | comment : calendar year ) , msb_store_returns.d_moy ( bigint | comment : calendar month ) ]
table item , columns = [ item.i_item_id ( varchar | comment : item id ) , item.i_rec_start_date ( date | comment : catalog record start ) , item.i_rec_end_date ( date | comment : catalog record end, nullable ) , item.i_category ( varchar | comment : category | values : Sports , Books ) , item.i_brand ( varchar | comment : brand ) ]
